router.email: Route to email skill (summarise, triage, draft, find).
router.calendar: Route to calendar skill (agenda, free slot, draft create/move/cancel).
router.sheet: Route to sheet skill (SQL over open sheet or selected range).
router.escalate: Hand off to frontier with consent (J11 or global escalate triggers).
router.general: Unsupported or chit-chat: answer or decline politely (J12); no v1 tool.

escalation.local: Handle on-device with v1 tools; no frontier handoff.
escalation.escalate: Hand off to a frontier model with user consent.

escalate_reasons.low_confidence: Router confidence is low; intent unclear, do not guess.
escalate_reasons.multi_step: Multi-step request; J10 deferred, escalate with consent in v1.
escalate_reasons.schema_failed: Tool args failed schema validation twice; local path stuck.
escalate_reasons.messy_sheet: Sheet is messy (merged cells, multi-header); escalate.
escalate_reasons.cross_sheet_join: Needs a join across sheets; escalate.
escalate_reasons.why_or_forecast: Causal or forecast question, not a lookup; escalate.
escalate_reasons.ambiguous: Ambiguous sheet question with no clear metric or range.
escalate_reasons.user_requested: User explicitly asked to escalate (J11 consent).
